messages:
maria: heads up — publish blocked on CI. regen diff is non-deterministic for the changelog header again, different ordering between runs :grimace:
ryan: ugh. which pipeline? typegen or openapi pipeline?
amanda: typegen run triggered by the release workflow (v0.18 -> v0.19 candidate). I saw the diff in changelogs where entries swap order even though no files changed. attaching snippet:
```
- 2026-03-01  fixed: samplekit auth retry behavior
- 2026-03-02  perf: batch sizing suggestion
+ 2026-03-02  perf: batch sizing suggestion
+ 2026-03-01  fixed: samplekit auth retry behavior
```
maria: CI treats that as a semantics change so semver bump logic flips from patch -> minor and blocks the publish.
ci-bot: build #4821 failed — regendiff check failed (changelog ordering mismatch). See https://ci.redwood/4821/logs
ryan: could be unstable sorting from example ordering in OpenAPI generator. We saw similar when examples had map iteration. Any reproducible command?
amanda: yes — locally `make typegen` then `git status --porcelain` shows files changed. Running twice flips the order. Minimal repro: run `yarn regen --openapi ./specs/samplekit.yaml --seed 42` twice.
jen: `--seed` helped last time. Is the seed being applied to the example collection sort? Maybe a nondet walk over properties.
luis: I dug in — the generator collects example keys via Object.keys() which relies on insertion order. When parsing example sets from multiple includes, the merge order depends on filesystem traversal order. That traversal changed between CI agents (mac vs linux?) which explains the flip.
amanda: ahhh. different FS order between runners. Nice catch.
maria: options: stable-sort keys in typegen, or canonicalize changelog output (sort entries by date+title) as a short-term hack. Which do we prefer?
ryan: long-term we want stable generator output. Short-term canonical changelog sort would unblock publish quickly.
jen: I can prepare the PR for canonicalizing changelog lines — trivial patch in the changelog writer: sort by ISO date then title. Want that in a hotfix branch.
luis: I'll prepare a follow-up PR to change generator to use a deterministic sort of example keys (and add unit). That will prevent future nondet diffs.
amanda: timeline? If jen opens hotfix PR we can run the publish job again.
jen: opening PR in 5m — https://git.redwood/pr/4521 — small patch, tests updated. cc @amanda @luis
ci-bot: PR 4521 triggered — running regen-check, typegen, and publish gating jobs.
ci-bot: PR 4521 — regen-check passed. typegen build passed. publish gate cleared. :tada:
maria: fantastic. will resume release flow. thanks everyone.
devex-bot: note — created follow-up ticket DEVEX-1189 to make typegen deterministic and add cross-platform CI job.
